scope.description: Whole cantera application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Thermodynamic phases, chemical equilibrium, reaction kinetics, reactor networks, transport, flames and mechanism management.

coverage.rationale: Thermodynamics, equilibrium and closed-reactor kinetics with fixed-bath thermal exchange form useful connected workflows, but one mechanism and strict ideal-gas bounds still exclude much of Cantera.

scope.description: Hydrogen/oxygen ideal-gas property/equilibrium sweeps and closed reactor ignition/cooling histories with optional fixed-bath total conductance.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Physical state, held pressure/volume, total bath conductance, temperature and labelled checked energy outputs replace native network setup; users still choose species, sample times and solver tolerances.

limitations: Ten-species h2o2 mechanism only; no carbon chemistry, condensed phases, transport, open or multiple-reactor networks, moving/radiating walls, finite baths, surfaces or flames.

Editorial estimate with unchanged 10% breadth and 75% abstraction scores; no exhaustive native API denominator. Newly run native evidence qualifies only named thermal and retained baseline cases, separately from these subjective scores.
